description: This file defines a custom React hook named useProfile which interacts with the memberships store to fetch and return user profile data. It is adapted for an auth-disabled environment, with no automatic profile loading. It also exports the hook as the default export.

methods.name: useProfile()
methods.description: Custom React hook that retrieves the user profile from the memberships store, without auto-loading in an auth-disabled setup. Returns null if no profile is available.
